rites.name: Xaethasha
rites.text: Xaethasha is a concept of Karugurn, the first tone that settles into the world's roots during the Singing, before any date is kept. It carries no will of its own, only the pull by which scattered sounds gather into form.

rites.name: Osyuthith
rites.text: Osyuthith is the concept of a sounding that rises through the Singing, the note by which the first roots of Karugurn gather into the soil. It is named in the groves of the first sovereign as the pull that bends seedlings toward light and water.

rites.name: Meramaari
rites.text: Meramaari is a concept within Karugurn, a notion of a ritual tool bound to the Courts and their divine trials. It is said to have been forged during councils that set the first doors between worlds, and it is kept in the temples of the Holy Age's flame-orders.

rites.name: Tirniarum
rites.text: A small, grey, jagged circle wraps around its bearer and harms foes who draw near. When many foes crowd inside its reach, only one of them suffers the harm.

rites.name: Ukamaroma
rites.text: Ukamaroma is a concept of the Karugurn universe, imagined during the Seeding, when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath the soil of the Grounded Realm. It is a principle of stillness and patient growth rather than a force that strikes or breaks.

rites.name: Ceolium
rites.text: A bond that forms when a young creature first sees a guardian after emerging. Once fixed, the young one periodically grants its keeper a brief surge of speed, swiftness of foot, and quicker mending of wounds.

rites.name: Tialires
rites.text: A dying-blow effect that leaves a path of scorched ground behind the bearer after each slain foe. The trail mirrors the scorch left by a pair of heavy stride-shoes worn by the fallen.

rites.name: Meosaulia
rites.text: Meosaulia is a concept of the Karugurn cosmos, a principle of binding that the old peoples named as the thread holding the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards together. It is remembered in the stories told during the Pact's oath, where it appears as a sealing force rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Coreolor
rites.text: A shared mechanic in which strikes drain the vitality of both foes and bearers until one falls. Harm flows from gear, rites and trinkets, taking many colored shapes, some stirring, some lingering, some striking deeper.

rites.name: Teosium
rites.text: Teosium is a concept of Karugurn born in the Walled Age, when orders of wall-keepers and first crossings held the land together for centuries. During the Age of Sundering, landfall broke the old bonds and the concept survives only as a memory of walls that once stood. Its power is measured in the stone and rope its people could move, not in anything cosmic.

rites.name: Amornaunes
rites.text: A practitioner may alter the recorded tallies within a keeper's sealed ledger to shift one's standing in the realm. Wise keepers advise playing the path honestly, since shortcuts dull the reward, and the seal grants no honors unless the realm itself announces them.

rites.name: Raustus
rites.text: A sealed ember-shell that turns its bearer into a flying fireball. It bursts after a few quiet moments or when the bearer chooses, and each foe struck along the way resets the countdown.

rites.name: Lauranum
rites.text: A charm that, when triggered, wraps its bearer in a ring of cold blue fire for a short spell. Anything caught inside is seared, foes most of all, and the burn lingers briefly after the flames fade.

rites.name: Ceornanum
rites.text: A glowing fallen stone that, when called upon, dims the surroundings and sends burning fragments raining across the land. Bright rings mark where each fragment will land, letting wanderers dodge the worst of it, though not every strike can be avoided.

rites.name: Serialestia
rites.text: A dark blob is hurled from the holder's hand, and where it lands a sticky double of the bearer forms. The double hits harder and endures longer than its maker, but it dissolves after half a minute no matter how it is mended.

rites.name: Osazeth
rites.text: Osazeth is a concept in the Karugurn universe, a notion that gives shape to the moment the ending forks into three futures and the Library files each outcome on its own shelf. It is less a being than a principle, a way the Grounded Realm keeps its branches from blurring together.
